content: op-sqlite + drizzle-orm migration pitfalls: (1) Metro bundler does not recognize .sql files by default; must add babel-plugin-inline-import with .sql extension to babel.config.js AND extend metro.config.js sourceExts. Missing either causes runtime crash when migrations are imported. (2) drizzle.config.ts must set driver: 'expo' (or 'op-sqlite'). (3) Schema changes without migrations crash existing users on app update. (4) Migrations run on app startup via useMigrations hook; if migration fails the app is stuck — need error handling and fallback. (5) SQL files must be bundled as strings via inline import for OP SQLite.
